classification_guide.sharepoint_artifact: Characters commonly introduced by SharePoint/Word rich-text editing. These are the main cleanup targets alongside zero-width spaces.
classification_guide.typography: Editor typography and invisible spacing characters. Often safe to normalize when converting content to plain ASCII text.
classification_guide.control_whitespace: Line breaks and tabs. Usually intentional in Contact fields, but worth reviewing in HTML fields.
classification_guide.data_quality: Characters that indicate encoding or data-entry problems rather than normal editorial styling.
classification_guide.legitimate_content: Valid multilingual content such as accented Latin names, transliteration marks, Arabic/Urdu poetry, and intentional symbols like £ or °. Do not strip these during routine SharePoint cleanup.
classification_guide.inferred: No explicit note exists yet for this character. Classification was inferred from Unicode category and script.
